decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe performs above aspiration in a growing geothermal market, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The single-U probe is a core standard item in the firm's established geothermal range, and the growing heat-pump demand keeps its results near aspiration.
The surface technology line extends the firm's materials expertise, and the slack of a large firm allows it to keep the line while its results remain uncertain.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the established building-systems business and serve demand driven by regulation, so they likely meet aspiration.
The slim steel profile system is close to the firm's established core offer, and with no evidence of a shortfall management keeps it.
The decorative surface system is a niche add-on with less certain demand, but the firm's slack and its low carrying cost favour keeping it.
